create_quantile_regressor: create a QuantileRegressor instance with configurable quantile, alpha, fit_intercept, and solver parameters
fit_quantile_regressor: fit a QuantileRegressor model on training data X and y with optional sample weights
predict_quantile_regressor: predict conditional quantile values from a fitted QuantileRegressor model using new input data
score_quantile_regressor: score a fitted QuantileRegressor model on test data X and y returning mean loss
identify_quantile_properties: inspect a fitted QuantileRegressor for coef_, intercept_, n_iter_, and feature_names_in_ attributes
